t: A description of how people are made
a: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
p: Inna-l-insāna khuliqa halūʿā, idhā massahu-sh-sharru jazūʿā, wa idhā massahu-l-khayru manūʿā, illa-l-muṣallīn.
m: Indeed, mankind was created anxious: When evil touches him, impatient, And when good touches him, withholding [of it], Except the observers of prayer - Those who are constant in their prayer
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
